verdict.rationale: Epic officially documents generating Python stub files (Developer Mode → Intermediate/PythonStub) with per-IDE setup for autocomplete. A generated per-class Python API reference backs it. Together these are first-party typed API definitions an editor can attach to. They cover only editor Python scripting: the Python API is marked Experimental, stubs require an opt-in setting and editor restart, and nothing comparable is documented for Blueprint gameplay scripting. Missing for 10: an official language server, documented diagnostics/navigation support beyond autocomplete, machine tooling for the primary gameplay scripting path (Blueprints), a non-experimental status, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
